card.line: Mount Gilead is the mountain where Gideon's army gathered, and where the LORD began shrinking it so Israel would know the victory came from Him.

moments.title: The fearful turn back
moments.text: The LORD told Gideon he had too many men, so that Israel would not boast that their own hand had saved them. Gideon announced that anyone fearful could leave Mount Gilead, and twenty-two thousand went home, leaving ten thousand.
